"""Structural + objective verification without re-deriving the atlas (fast)."""
import ipaddress, json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from audit import decode_image, WIDTH, LANES
U=1<<128

def check(request, result, rng=None, samples=40):
    rng=rng or random.Random(3)
    total_runs=0
    for case,res in zip(request["cases"],result["cases"]):
        assert set(res)=={"versions","changes","bursts","objective"}
        assert len(res["versions"])==len(case["transactions"])+1
        work=pages=resident=0
        vinfo=[]
        for vi,out in enumerate(res["versions"]):
            starts=[int(x,16) for x in out["starts"]]
            assert starts[0]==0 and all(a<b for a,b in zip(starts,starts[1:])), "starts order"
            assert len(starts)<=64, "run bound"
            total_runs+=len(starts)
            nodes,size=decode_image(out["image"],starts,out["hops"])
            pages+=size
            resident+=sum(n["pages"] for n in nodes.values() if n["cached"])
            vinfo.append((starts,out["hops"],nodes))
            # traversal lands on the advertised run for random addresses
            for _ in range(samples):
                x=rng.getrandbits(128)
                off=64
                while True:
                    n=nodes[off]
                    if n["kind"]:
                        rank=n["lo"]+len([k for k in n["keys"] if k<=x])-1; break
                    off=n["children"][len([k for k in n["keys"] if k<=x])]
                lo=max(i for i,s in enumerate(starts) if s<=x)
                assert rank==lo and out["hops"][rank]==out["hops"][lo]
        assert total_runs<=128, "total run bound"
        assert resident<=case["cache_pages"], "resident"
        assert len(res["changes"])==len(case["transactions"])
        for ci,row in enumerate(res["changes"]):
            a,b=ci,ci+1
            sa,ha=vinfo[a][0],vinfo[a][1]; sb,hb=vinfo[b][0],vinfo[b][1]
            bounds=sorted(set(sa)|set(sb))
            want=[]
            for i,x in enumerate(bounds):
                nxt=bounds[i+1] if i+1<len(bounds) else U
                va=ha[max(j for j,s in enumerate(sa) if s<=x)]
                vb=hb[max(j for j,s in enumerate(sb) if s<=x)]
                if va!=vb: want.append([x,nxt,va,vb])
            merged=[]
            for r in want:
                if merged and merged[-1][1]==r[0] and merged[-1][2]==r[2] and merged[-1][3]==r[3]:
                    merged[-1][1]=r[1]
                else: merged.append(r)
            exp=[["%032x"%s if e<U else "1"+"0"*32, "%032x"%e if e<U else "1"+"0"*32, o, n] for s,e,o,n in merged]
            assert row==exp, ("changes",ci,row[:2],exp[:2])
        hit,miss,dec=case["costs"]["hit"],case["costs"]["miss"],case["costs"]["decode"]
        assert len(res["bursts"])==len(case["bursts"])
        for burst,answers in zip(case["bursts"],res["bursts"]):
            v=burst["version"]; starts,hops,nodes=vinfo[v]
            assert len(answers)==len(burst["addresses"])
            visits={}; touched=set()
            for text,answer in zip(burst["addresses"],answers):
                x=int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(text))
                lo=max(i for i,s in enumerate(starts) if s<=x)
                assert answer[0]==hops[lo] and answer[1]==lo, ("answer",answer,lo)
                off=64; path=[]
                while True:
                    path.append(off); n=nodes[off]
                    if n["kind"]:
                        r=n["lo"]+len([k for k in n["keys"] if k<=x])-1; break
                    off=n["children"][len([k for k in n["keys"] if k<=x])]
                assert answer[2]==path, "path"
                for o in path:
                    visits[o]=visits.get(o,0)+1; touched.add(o)
            for o in touched:
                n=nodes[o]; k=len(n["keys"])
                work+=burst["repeat"]*(n["pages"]*(hit if n["cached"] else miss)
                            +((k+LANES[n["mode"]]-1)//LANES[n["mode"]]+dec[n["mode"]])*visits[o])
        assert res["objective"]==[work,pages], ("objective",res["objective"],[work,pages])
    return True

import ipaddress, json, random, sys

def wide_same_hop(rng, n):
    """n routes that coalesce into a small number of forwarding runs."""
    rows=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        length=rng.choice([128,120,112,100,96,80,64])
        v=rng.getrandbits(128)
        size=1<<(128-length)
        rows.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v//size*size))+"/"+str(length), 7])
    rows.append(["::/0",7])
    return rows

def exact_runs(rng, count):
    """routes producing exactly `count` forwarding runs with distinct hops."""
    # pick count-1 increasing boundaries, each a /128 route with a distinct hop
    points=sorted(rng.sample(range(1,1<<127), count-1))
    rows=[["::/0", 0]]
    for i,p in enumerate(points):
        rows.append(["%032x/128"%p, i+1])
    return rows

def case_initial(rows): return [[t,h] for t,h in rows]

if __name__=="__main__":
    kind=sys.argv[1]
    rng=random.Random(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 5)
    if kind=="samehop":
        rows=wide_same_hop(rng, 30000)
        bursts=[{"version":0,"repeat":1000000,"addresses":["2001:db8::%x"%rng.getrandbits(40) for _ in range(64)]} for _ in range(127)]
        bursts+=[{"version":0,"repeat":1,"addresses":[]}]
        case={"initial":case_initial(rows),
              "transactions":[[[ "set", r[0], rng.randint(0,20)] for r in rng.sample(rows,20)] for _ in range(7)],
              "bursts":bursts,"cache_pages":12,
              "costs":{"hit":1,"miss":256,"decode":[0,3,16]}}
        print(json.dumps({"cases":[case]*1}))
    elif kind=="maxruns":
        # two versions with exactly 64 runs each: 128 total
        rows=exact_runs(rng,64)
        tx=[[["set","::/0",1]]]
        bursts=[{"version":v,"repeat":rng.randint(1,1000),
                 "addresses":["%032x"%rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(64)]}
                for v in (0,1) for _ in range(60)]
        case={"initial":case_initial(rows),"transactions":tx,"bursts":bursts,
              "cache_pages":12,"costs":{"hit":2,"miss":40,"decode":[1,0,2]}}
        print(json.dumps({"cases":[case]}))
    elif kind=="over":
        rows=exact_runs(rng,65)
        print(json.dumps({"cases":[{"initial":case_initial(rows),"transactions":[],"bursts":[],
              "cache_pages":0,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":2,"decode":[0,0,0]}}]}))
    elif kind=="many":
        cases=[]
        for k in range(4):
            rows=exact_runs(rng,rng.randint(20,32))
            bursts=[{"version":0,"repeat":rng.randint(1,50),
                     "addresses":["%032x"%rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(64)]} for _ in range(64)]
            cases.append({"initial":case_initial(rows),"transactions":[],"bursts":bursts,
                          "cache_pages":6,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":16,"decode":[0,1,2]}})
        print(json.dumps({"cases":cases}))
